snippet.title: Good Morning is Good Night - Trailer
snippet.description:
Take a casual walk through space and time to cheer up a friend. 

Good Morning is Good Night is a relaxing adventure game meant to put you at ease. Feel yourself unwind as you explore a sleepy little town and perform acts of kindness that transcend time.

Play now on itch.io: https://piratetune.itch.io/good-morning-is-good-night

Art & Writing by Viv -  https://twitter.com/_smuckz (twitter) / https://smuckerz.itch.io (itch.io)
Code & Audio by Paul - https://twitter.com/PaulSim_ (twitter) / https://piratetune.itch.io (itch.io)
